claims.scope: Formal update/projection properties under the assumptions stated in Chapter 3; this does not establish detector accuracy or closed-loop benefit.
claims.permitted_wording: The method specifies evidence-linked state updates and a causal projection contract under explicit assumptions.

claims.scope: Locked V2 T1/T3/base dataset inventory and observation/action/image alignment only.
claims.permitted_wording: The V2 corpus contains 698 episodes and passed the recorded alignment audit over 180,447 state/action rows and 1,396 adapter-parity samples.

claims.scope: Six previously observed T1/T3 demonstrations from the historical RGB cycle-writer audit. Historical F1 validation compares the same checkpoint at step 3000 with and without memory.
claims.permitted_wording: The earlier cycle-writer audit matched its annotated milestones on the selected demonstrations within the reported tolerance. On 4299 Mem validation frames, flow matching loss was 0.2302 with memory and 0.3355 with memory removed.

claims.scope: Historical B0/F1 T1/T3 evaluation with 20 task episodes per condition.
claims.permitted_wording: Historical B0 recorded 0/20 successes and historical F1 recorded 1/20, on T3, under the local protocol.

claims.scope: Matched V2 F0/F1 E2 unseen evaluation, separate one-state event pilot, offline E2 shadow replay, and completed 24-pair D2 shadow/event development cohort on seen T1/T3 states and a descriptive audit of evidence-ID freshness for its 56 event requeries.
claims.permitted_wording: E2 used fixed 10-action queries and did not evaluate evidence-triggered exploration. The separate D2 seen-development cohort completed 24 paired episodes per arm with matching initial-state hashes. Event mode issued 56 logged requeries in 22/24 episodes; all 56 resulting facts carried an evidence ID, but only 41/56 decisions added new evidence IDs. The remaining 15 only appended “History incomplete.” to the prior bowl fact and retained IDs from observations 0–2; their evidence age had median 73 actions and range 32–758. No evidence-age threshold or decision-correctness labels were predeclared. Shadow issued no early requery. Both arms succeeded 1/24; paired SR difference was zero and mean SCR difference was +0.056 with a state-group bootstrap 95% interval [-0.125, 0.250]. This confirms closed-loop event activation but does not establish an efficacy benefit. The offline E2 replay reconstructed 3,969/3,969 prompts and flagged candidates on fixed trajectories without issuing queries or changing actions. None of these results is an official LIBERO score.
claims.prohibited_wording: Claiming that memory or event-triggered retrieval improves task success; claiming that E2 tests active evidence-triggered exploration; treating the one-state event/periodic pilot as an efficacy estimate; treating offline replay candidates as actual re-queries or changed actions; or presenting these custom runs as official LIBERO scores.

claims.scope: One T1 seen demo_1/state 0 event-mode rollout and one same-state/seed periodic reference, F1 V2 checkpoint with logged writer-source override, 1000-action horizons; query cadence is not matched and no shadow comparator was run.
claims.permitted_wording: The event-mode supervisor triggered one evidence-backed requery at step 3 after three executed actions, using the projected fact 'bowl: 0 observed returns.' Event used 101 queries/1144.01 s; the same-state periodic reference used 125 queries/1229.75 s. Both reached 1000 actions with 0/1 subgoals, SCR 0, and no overshoot. The different query cadence and one-state sample make this descriptive, not an efficacy estimate.
claims.prohibited_wording: Claiming that event-mode requery improves decisions or task success, or treating this one-state non-comparable pilot as a benchmark score.

claims.scope: Two seen state-0 episodes (T1/T3), one seed, comparing F1 projected-text and shadow observer arms; development trace/parity only.
claims.permitted_wording: On T1/T3 seen state0 with seed 42, shadow logged one evidence-backed semantic change at step 3 per task and continued without an early query. Both arms used 100 queries per episode; prompt rows and action/query-step/action-chunk arrays were identical in 2/2 pairs. Both arms recorded 0/2 successes. This verifies observer parity, not early-requery efficacy. A separate one-state D2 event pilot did execute one early requery, with unmatched query cadence.
claims.prohibited_wording: Claiming that D1 shadow issued a requery or improved policy success; treating D1/D2 development pilots as official LIBERO scores or evidence of a memory-performance benefit.

claims.scope: Writer and checkpoint identities for the historical T3 analysis, E2/E6, and the supplementary B0 raw unseen run; B0-to-E2 outcome contrast is descriptive because source/runtime snapshots differ.
claims.permitted_wording: Historical F1 used rgb_cycle_v3 at 3000 steps. E2 used the matched V2 adapter pair at 5000 steps with F1 bound to rgb_relations_v1. E6 used the same F1 weights with memory off.

claims.scope: One successful historical F1 T3 rollout; matched B0 summary and decoded camera footage.
claims.permitted_wording: The evaluator reached milestones at 190, 626 and 863. The writer confirmed two returns, at 198 and 882, first reflected at queries 200 and 890. The episode finished successfully at 1000; matched B0 reached no milestones.

claims.scope: One T1 state and policy seed, four query times, two interventions per query.
claims.permitted_wording: At query 670, removing memory or providing an evidence-backed fact changed the first ten executed actions by L2 distances of 2.715 and 4.306. All eight interventions still overshot.

claims.scope: Local paired LIBERO-10 E6 roster with 50 pairs, using the E2 F1 weights with memory off.
claims.permitted_wording: B0 recorded 37/50 and F1-off 23/50. There were 19 B0-only and 5 F1-off-only successes. A 10,000-draw paired-state bootstrap, stratified within the 10 fixed tasks, gave a descriptive 95% interval of -42 to -14 percentage points for F1-off minus B0, conditional on this roster. This does not establish a causal memory effect. For task 5, F1-off lifted the object in 3/5 episodes and placed it in none.

claims.scope: Descriptive WSL/Linux rerun of the E6 B0 arm on the same 50 LIBERO-10 task/state/seed pairs as the historical Windows run; execution runtime and source revision differ.
claims.permitted_wording: On the same 50 task/state/seed pairs, the WSL rerun recorded 33/50 successes versus 37/50 historically and agreed on 34/50 outcomes: 27 both-success, 10 historical-only, 6 rerun-only, and 7 both-fail pairs. Because platform, Python, simulator, BDDL, and source revision differed together, this is a reproducibility diagnostic, not an official LIBERO score or an estimate of policy effect.

claims.scope: One custom V2 LIBERO-Mem B0 raw run on the exact 40 initial-state hashes used by E2 F0/F1, T1/T3, seed 42; source/runtime differences preclude direct causal comparison.
claims.permitted_wording: B0 completed 40/40 episodes with 0/40 successes, mean SCR 0.0167, and no overshoots. The B0 and E2 rosters share 40/40 initial-state hashes, but only 115/134 source hashes match and policy Python/Torch/CUDA runtimes differ; the contrast is descriptive only.
claims.prohibited_wording: Calling B0-versus-E2 differences a causal adaptation or memory effect, or reporting this custom run as an official LIBERO score.

claims.scope: Preflight of the derived-v1 F1 export for a T1/T3 test-split rollout; preflight failed before any episode was run.
claims.permitted_wording: The derived-v1 closed-loop evaluation was blocked before rollout because the current grounding_dino.py SHA-256 differed from the export-attested source hash; zero episodes were executed.
claims.prohibited_wording: Reporting any closed-loop success rate for the derived-v1 export, or bypassing the source hash mismatch as if provenance had been verified.

claims.scope: D2 calibration-state preflight for seen state indices 12-19, T1/T3, seed 42; preflight blocked before the planned shadow/event rollout.
claims.permitted_wording: The D2 calibration extension was blocked before rollout because F1 writer-source hashes differed from the current checkout; zero episodes were executed.
claims.prohibited_wording: Reporting calibration-cohort D2 metrics or bypassing the writer-source hash validation.

claims.scope: E3 renderer-only sweep on the 24 D2 event-projected development episodes (T1/T3 seen states 0–11, seed 42), replaying 2,397 query snapshots at residual-token fractions 0, 1/3, 2/3, and full.
claims.permitted_wording: Re-rendering at the original 48-token budget exactly reproduced 2,397/2,397 recorded prompts and renderer metadata. On fixed snapshots, zero residual tokens delivered no candidate facts; one-third delivered 90.2% of T1 and 35.1% of T3 candidate facts; two-thirds and full delivered 100% for both tasks. This measures renderer delivery only; lower-budget prompts were not passed to the policy.
claims.prohibited_wording: Claiming that the budget sweep changed policy actions, closed-loop success, decision correctness, or causal efficacy.

claims.scope: One T1 seen-development state-7 D2 event trajectory, policy seed 42, intervention at query step 142; one exact-prompt replay control and one branch suppressing memory text at that query only.
claims.permitted_wording: On this single successful state, the exact-prompt event-mode rerun reproduced all 1000/1000 actions and succeeded. Removing memory text at query 142 changed the target action chunk after an exact 142/142 action prefix and the branch completed 0/1 subgoals (SCR 0). This is a case-specific counterfactual, not a population-level efficacy estimate.
claims.prohibited_wording: Claiming that memory generally improves task success, extrapolating this one-state intervention to other states/tasks/seeds, or presenting the custom run as an official LIBERO score.

claims.scope: Offline descriptive join of bowl_1.returns from the online F1 memory trace and evaluator confirmed_cycles from all 48 completed D2 episodes: 24 matched shadow/event task-state-seed assignments, T1/T3 seen states 0-11, policy seed 42.
claims.permitted_wording: At episode end, memory return counts exactly matched evaluator confirmed-cycle counts in event T1 10/12, event T3 8/12, shadow T1 6/12, and shadow T3 10/12. Across these traces, the comparison is descriptive only: no predeclared timing tolerance or blind identity/relation/intent labels were used, so these counts are not writer accuracy or FP/FN rates.
claims.prohibited_wording: Do not call endpoint agreement writer accuracy, infer identity/relation correctness or FP/FN rates, or generalize beyond the logged T1/T3 D2 cohort.

claims.scope: One T1 seen-development state-5 D2 shadow trajectory, policy seed 42, intervention at query step 10; one exact-prompt replay control and one branch removing the evidence-backed initial bowl-return fact for that query only.
claims.permitted_wording: On this second successful state, the exact-prompt shadow-mode rerun reproduced all 1000/1000 source actions and succeeded. Removing the evidence-backed “bowl: 0 observed returns” fact at query 10 changed the action chunk (first-action L2 0.1504) after an exact 10/10 action prefix; the branch then completed 0/1 subgoals (SCR 0) at 1000 steps. This is a second single-state diagnostic, not a population-level efficacy estimate.
claims.prohibited_wording: Do not generalize the two successful-state counterfactuals to population-level memory efficacy, call them official LIBERO scores, or claim identity/relation accuracy.

claims.scope: Descriptive evidence-ID comparison in 56 event-mode requeries from the 24-episode D2 seen T1/T3 development cohort; evidence-age values use query step minus one and the largest referenced RGB/gripper observation index.
claims.permitted_wording: All 56 D2 event requery facts carried an evidence ID; 41 decisions added new evidence IDs. Fifteen only appended “History incomplete.” and retained nine IDs from observations 0–2; those IDs had median age 73 actions (range 32–758). No predeclared age threshold or correctness labels were used, so this describes logged provenance freshness and does not estimate decision accuracy or efficacy.
claims.prohibited_wording: Do not call evidence-ID presence evidence correctness, claim that carried evidence was fresh or stale under a validated threshold, infer writer/decision accuracy, or claim causal policy benefit from this descriptive audit.
